definitions.explanation: An estimate of income and expenditure for a set period; the amount of money available for spending.

examples.japanese: {予算|よさん}は{いくら}ですか。
{予算|よさん}を{超|こ}えてしまった。
examples.notes: 予算を超える = to exceed the budget

examples.japanese: {来年度|らいねんど}の{予算|よさん}を{組|く}む。
examples.english: To draw up next year's budget.
examples.notes: 予算を組む = to draw up/formulate a budget

notes:
USAGE: {予算|よさん} is used in both personal finance and business/government contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{予算|よさん}を{組|く}む (to draw up a budget)
・{予算|よさん}を{超|こ}える (to exceed the budget)
・{予算|よさん}{内|ない} (within budget)
・{予算|よさん}{案|あん} (budget proposal)
・{予算|よさん}{削減|さくげん} (budget cuts)

RELATED:
・{国家|こっか}{予算|よさん} (national budget)
・{年間|ねんかん}{予算|よさん} (annual budget)
